pages.text: Craft a Bloodtox starter with the armor core, military circuitry and redstone. A command key offers a second recipe. Use the starter on the truck in normal mode. Keep the emergence area clear with solid ground.

Wait for Greene's human body to emerge. In Prototype mode, switch to unarmed or claws, close in, press Grab (default E), then Use once you have her. She breaks free and leaves living tissue behind. In Backspines form, Grab recalls your spines.$(br2)$(l:den)Track the den$(/l)
